hypothesis: Increasing semantically irrelevant direct-context length may reduce normalized-exact retrieval accuracy while the relevant fact, answer complexity, question form, evidence position policy, inference settings, and evaluator remain fixed.
null_result: Accuracy may remain stable across the tested ladder; absence of degradation is valid evidence.

case_generation.model_specific_budgeting: Each model receives a deterministic prefix of the same distractor sequence. The terminal distractor count may differ because model tokenizers differ; requested and actual counts are retained.

evidence_position.note: The ratio is measured within the context records, excluding fixed chat-template and question overhead. Symmetric distractor pairs keep position stable across levels.

metrics.reliability_rule: ECC threshold is the last level in the contiguous tested prefix meeting the threshold; a later isolated recovery does not raise ECC.

success_criteria: ECC95, ECC90, and ECC80 derived only with complete supporting data
same definition reusable across both qualified models
